description: One historical writer's interpretation of one passage. Quotation, explanation, context, and citation. See RESEARCH-STANDARDS.md sections 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6.

alternativeReadings.description: Dissenting / alternative readings of the same passage (standards section 6). Empty until researched.

summary.description: The dissenting or alternative reading, fairly stated.

authorId.description: Id from shared/authors.json. Must exist there, or be explicitly marked pending.

citation.description: Full citation: work, edition/translation, stable locator (public-domain URL where available, e.g. CCEL / New Advent, plus print citation). Null until researched.

explanation.description: What the writer is saying in this passage and how the quotation supports it. Null until researched.

historicalContext.description: Historical / theological context: when the work was written, what debate it belongs to, who it was written against. Dates are writing dates with certainty (standards section 5).

id.description: Stable slug, e.g. justin-martyr-gen-1-26-001. Unique within the doctrine.

notes.description: Researcher notes. Never a substitute for a verified field.

passageId.description: Id of the passage being interpreted. Must exist in the doctrine's passages file, or be explicitly marked pending in notes — never silently invented.

quotation.description: The verified quotation. Null until a quotation has been checked against a primary source. If the quotation is not legally reproducible, text is null and summary is used instead (standards section 3.4).

edition.description: Edition used, e.g. editor, series, year.

language.description: Language of the quoted text, e.g. Greek, Latin, English.

location.description: Location in the work: book / chapter / section / paragraph as the edition numbers it.

reproducibilityStatus.description: Whether the quotation may lawfully be reproduced here.

summary.description: Researcher's own-words summary, used instead of text when reproducibilityStatus is not-reproducible, and optionally alongside text.

text.description: Verbatim quoted text. Null if not reproducible.

translation.description: Translator of the quoted text, or null for the original language. The researcher's own translation must be labelled as such.

relationshipToDoctrine.description: How this interpretation bears on the doctrine. Must attribute the reading to the writer (standards section 2, row C) and never present it as the text's plain meaning.

verificationRecordIds.description: Ids of verification records covering claims in this interpretation.

workId.description: Id from shared/works.json. Must exist there, or be explicitly marked pending.
